_what_this_is: Names this page attributes work to, and the record that somebody opened the author list of the document itself rather than trusting a title we transcribed. Created 2026-09-04, when a source entry added to the list a reader sees carried a byline and lint_claims blocked on it. The check exists because 'Jacot and colleagues' was published from gate output while fixing an attribution gap, and the paper is by Tanguy et al.
